meta.testSeedNote: Full specified test set. All reported performance numbers use test seeds only; tuning used seeds 1-100.
meta.alertDefinition: zone level alert; detection before outbreakDay + 14
meta.specificityDefinition: share of calm zone-days on/after day 28 with no alert
meta.falseAlertDefinition: alert zone-days per zone per 30 observed days (days 28-59) in calm runs

tuning.note: No threshold was changed after seeing the test set. The pre-registered CLUSTER thresholds were used.

metrics.dataSource: MIT-BIH Atrial Fibrillation Database (PhysioNet afdb v1.0.0)
